candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment that updates betLimit so the bet limit never changes.
Set betLimit to the passed amount scaled by 2 so the stored value differs from the requested amount.
Change the access check so anyone (not just the owner) can adjust the bet limit, exposing differing behavior via AdjustBetAmounts.
Change the assignment so difficulty is set to amount + 1 instead of amount.
Delete the statement that updates difficulty, so difficulty retains its previous value after the call.
Invert the onlyOwner check so non-owners can pass the modifier, letting other callers change difficulty via AdjustDifficulty.
Delete the statement that sets openToPublic to true, so the contract never opens to the public.
Replace the assignment with openToPublic = false, so calling OpenToThePublic keeps the contract closed.
Invert the onlyOwner check to msg.sender != owner, allowing anyone except the owner to open the contract to the public.
